methodology: Studio seeks via remotion_setFrame and data-ad-frame; normalized data-ad-design coordinates; text ranges filtered by ancestor opacity and overflow masks. UI intersections are geometric concerns, not pixel-perfect occlusion proofs. Final audio end boundary is outside the composition and is clamped to the last valid frame. Screenshots capture Studio, not rendered exports.
